zh.title: FAA推出MedGuide藥物查詢指南供飛行員與航管人員使用
zh.summary: FAA推出MedGuide線上指南，供飛行員與航管人員查詢用藥及等待時間
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）推出線上指南MedGuide，協助美國飛行員與空中交通管制員查詢可使用的藥物，以及用藥後返回值勤前可能需要等待的時間。
MedGuide涵蓋處方藥與非處方藥，提供開始用藥或後續服用劑量後的等待時間資訊。首版只收錄FAA歸類為可使用的藥物；FAA計畫在後續更新加入有條件可接受及不可接受的藥物。藥物未出現在指南中，不代表可據此判定其能否在飛行時使用。
FAA表示，藥物獲準使用本身並不代表飛行員或管制員適合值勤；使用者也須考量自身健康狀況與副作用。MedGuide是參考資料，不能取代個人醫療評估或醫師建議。

en.title: FAA launches searchable MedGuide for pilots and air traffic controllers
en.summary: FAA launches MedGuide to help pilots and controllers check medication guidance and waiting periods.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has introduced MedGuide, an online tool for US pilots and air traffic controllers to check which medications they can take and how long they may need to wait before returning to duty. The searchable guide covers prescription and over-the-counter drugs, with waiting-period information after starting a medication or taking later doses.

The first version includes only medications the FAA categorizes as allowed. The agency plans to add conditionally acceptable and unacceptable medications in future updates; a medication’s absence from the guide does not determine whether it can be used while flying. The FAA also says an allowed medication alone does not establish fitness for duty: users must consider their medical condition and any side effects. MedGuide is a reference, not a substitute for an individual medical assessment or a doctor’s advice.

zh.summary: 達美航空A350-1000將配置101個高端座位，長程策略轉向較高票價
body: Simple Flying報導，達美航空的A350-1000將配置101個高端座位。報導摘要也指出，達美航空正將長程策略轉向較高票價、套房產品與忠誠度收入。
報導所述的座位數，是這款飛機將配置的高端座位數；摘要所述的策略方向則涵蓋票價、套房與忠誠度收入。這則消息同時提及A350-1000的座位配置，以及達美航空長程策略的調整方向。

The reported cabin figure is 101 premium seats on the A350-1000. The strategic direction described in the summary includes higher fares, suites and loyalty revenue. The item thus reports both an aircraft configuration and a shift in Delta Air Lines’ long-haul strategy; it does not give a further seat breakdown or state a separate operational change.

body: Simple Flying報導，美國航空取消九條波音777航線。報導摘要另稱，機隊調整使長程777-200ER服務改由Dreamliners與窄體客機執飛，相關調整遍及多個主要樞紐。

The report gives the cancellation figure as nine Boeing 777 routes. The aircraft change it describes concerns long-haul 777-200ER services, and names Dreamliners and narrowbodies as the aircraft taking over those services. The summary characterizes the service changes as part of a fleet reshuffle.

根據 Simple Flying 的摘要，西南航空將以三個忠誠等級取代原有的 A-List。
同一報導指出，此次調整也包含新的同伴票（Companion Pass）福利。
報導並提到，改版內容包括擴大國際獎勵機會。
上述內容為 Simple Flying 的報導摘要，未提供新制度的生效日期、適用對象或申請條件等進一步細節。
目前可確認的資訊僅限於西南航空宣佈這項忠誠計畫改版，以及改版涵蓋的三項主要方向。

zh.title: 路易斯安那州Cessna 210墜毀 飛行員受輕傷
zh.summary: Cessna 210於路易斯安那州墜毀，飛行員受輕傷；引擎撞地前脫離
body: 一架Cessna 210於2026年10月13日在路易斯安那州Gonzales起飛後發生引擎脫離，隨後墜毀於Louisiana Regional Airport（REG）附近田地，機身最後倒置。AeroTime報導，74歲飛行員受輕傷。
Ascension Parish Sheriff Bobby Webre告訴WAFB，引擎在飛機撞地前脫離。飛行員在現場接受醫療人員評估，但拒絕由救護車送院；引擎脫離原因仍不明。

en.title: Cessna 210 crashes in Louisiana after engine separates; pilot has minor injuries
en.summary: A Cessna 210 crashed in Gonzales; the pilot suffered minor injuries after engine separation.
body: A Cessna 210 crashed in a field near Louisiana Regional Airport (REG), in Gonzales, Louisiana, on October 13, 2026, shortly after takeoff. The airplane came to rest upside down. AeroTime reported that the 74-year-old pilot suffered minor injuries.

Ascension Parish Sheriff Bobby Webre told WAFB that the engine separated before the aircraft hit the ground. Medical personnel assessed the pilot at the scene, but he declined ambulance transport to a hospital. The reason for the engine separation remains unclear.

zh.title: 法國空軍與太空軍2027年僅預計接收兩架飆風戰機
zh.summary: 法國空軍與太空軍預計2027年接收兩架飆風戰機，機隊使用率已超出規劃
body: 法國空軍與太空軍預計在2027年僅接收兩架新型飆風戰機，同時退役更多幻象2000-5戰機。AeroTime報導指出，法國現役作戰飛機的使用率已比原訂規劃高出15%以上。
法國空軍與太空軍參謀長 Jérôme Bellanger 將機隊壓力的警告，於2026年10月14日在法國國民議會國防委員會聽證會上提出。報導指出，2027年預算提案編列44億歐元承諾授權額與18億歐元支付額，用於飆風戰機採購及現代化，包括F5標準的研發；Bellanger並主張，下一部軍事規劃法應重新檢視法國戰機機隊的整體規模。

en.title: France’s Air and Space Force expects just two Rafales in 2027 amid fleet strain
en.summary: France’s Air and Space Force expects two Rafales in 2027 as fighter utilization exceeds planned levels.
body: France’s Air and Space Force expects to receive just two new Rafale fighters in 2027 while retiring additional Mirage 2000-5 jets. AeroTime reports that the country’s existing combat aircraft are already being used more than 15% above their planned utilization rate.

General Jérôme Bellanger, Chief of Staff of the French Air and Space Force, raised the fleet-pressure warning during a hearing before the National Assembly’s Defense Committee on October 14, 2026. The proposed 2027 budget allocates €4.4 billion in commitment authorizations and €1.8 billion in payment appropriations to Rafale procurement and modernization, including development of the F5 standard. Bellanger argued that the next military programming law should reconsider the overall size of France’s fighter fleet.

zh.title: 波音執行長將赴薩凡納與美國運輸部長討論認證改革
zh.summary: 波音執行長將在薩凡納與美國官員討論航空器認證改革
body: AeroTime援引彭博報導，波音執行長 Kelly Ortberg 將於 2026 年 10 月 15 日在美國喬治亞州薩凡納，與美國運輸部長 Sean Duffy 會面。RTX 的 Christopher Calio 及 GE Aerospace 的 Larry Culp 也將與會。與會者將討論如何簡化涉及航空器、零件及組件的認證流程。
美國交通部表示，Duffy 與聯邦航空總署署長 Bryan Bedford 曾將認證改革形容為兼顧飛行安全與美國航空產業競爭力的機會。交通部發言人另表示，若無法推動流程現代化，安全創新將落後。

en.title: Boeing CEO to Discuss Certification Reform with U.S. Transportation Secretary
en.summary: Boeing CEO to discuss certification reform with U.S. officials in Savannah.
body: AeroTime, citing Bloomberg, reports that Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg will meet U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy in Savannah, Georgia, on October 15, 2026. RTX’s Christopher Calio and GE Aerospace’s Larry Culp are also among the industry leaders who will meet. Participants will consider how the certification process involving aircraft, parts and components could be streamlined.

The Department of Transportation said Duffy and FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford had previously described certification reform as an opportunity to enhance safety for the flying public and maintain America’s aerospace competitiveness. A department spokesperson said that if the process cannot be modernized, safety innovation will lag.

zh.title: SITA同意收購Collins Aerospace機場解決方案事業
zh.summary: SITA宣佈收購Collins Aerospace機場科技事業；預計2027年上半年完成，財務條件未揭露
body: 日內瓦航空運輸資訊科技供應商SITA於2026年10月15日宣佈，已同意收購RTX旗下Collins Aerospace的機場科技事業Collins Aerospace Airport Solutions。
SITA表示，這筆交易預計在2027年上半年完成，仍須符合包括監管機關批准在內的一般條件；財務條件未予揭露。
Collins Aerospace Airport Solutions提供讓旅客與行李通過機場航廈的科技，產品涵蓋報到與自助服務櫃檯、行李託運，以及機場維持運作所需的作業系統。
SITA指出，合併雙方業務將強化其對客戶的支援，並改善旅客處理、行李處理及更廣泛的機場作業。
SITA執行長David Lavorel表示，旅客數與期待持續上升，意味產業需要在旅程每個階段讓科技與人員協同運作，以便快速預防或解決中斷情況；他說這項收購將擴大SITA的產品服務，並強化其作為客戶科技夥伴的角色。
SITA機場業務資深副總裁Nathalie Altwegg表示，機場希望供應商瞭解其作業、與其團隊緊密合作，並在需要支援時能夠到場；她說這項收購將讓SITA能向更多客戶提供這樣的服務。

en.title: SITA agrees to acquire Collins Aerospace Airport Solutions, deal expected to close in 2027
en.summary: SITA agrees to acquire Collins Aerospace Airport Solutions; deal expected to close in first half of 2027; financial terms undisclosed
body: SITA, the Geneva-based air transport IT provider, announced on October 15, 2026 that it has agreed to acquire Collins Aerospace Airport Solutions, the airport technology business of RTX's Collins Aerospace.
SITA said the deal is expected to close during the first half of 2027, subject to customary conditions including regulatory approvals. Financial terms were not disclosed.

Collins Aerospace Airport Solutions provides technology that moves passengers and their bags through airport terminals. Its products cover check-in and self-service kiosks, bag drop and the operational systems airports rely on to keep running.
SITA said combining the two businesses will strengthen its support for customers and improve passenger processing, baggage handling and wider airport operations.

SITA CEO David Lavorel said rising passenger numbers and expectations mean the industry needs technology and people working together across every stage of the journey, so that disruptions can be prevented or resolved quickly. He said the acquisition would expand SITA's offerings and reinforce its role as a technology partner to its customers.

Nathalie Altwegg, SITA's Senior Vice President for Airports, said airports want a provider that understands their operations, works closely with their teams and is available when support is needed. She said the acquisition would allow SITA to offer that to more customers.
